items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta, full launch, affiliate/advertising expansion, and external rights outreach; conditional for ordinary reversible work that adds no new data collection, permissions, credentials, dependencies, cross-site behavior, or unsupported claims. Evidence: Woot public terms do not establish public/commercial redistribution rights; source, privacy, consent, security, accuracy, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Fleet compliance is technical baseline only: 35 pass, 20 fail, 6 unknown, with open banner, consent, reject, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Analytics is unavailable for all expected sites and must remain unknown, not zero. Revenue evidence is limited to 2026-09-21 Amazon data with $4.92 aggregate unattributed commission; no revenue, ROI, margin, forecast, or causal-lift claim is supported. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private and preview-only; do not send rights outreach or change the gate. Continue only existing evidence work and require human counsel for upstream rights, jurisdictional privacy, and any public monetization or advertising decision.
